ModMetaData.name: Harvest and Haul
ModMetaData.author: silvanalig95
ModMetaData.description:
Pawns bring their own harvest to storage.
In vanilla, a pawn harvests a field, chops trees or picks berries and leaves everything lying on the ground for somebody else to haul later. With this mod the harvester puts the yield into its inventory while working and takes it to storage itself:
- The pawn keeps harvesting as long as the next harvest still fits into its inventory. - When it is full, it stops harvesting, delivers everything, and can come back for more afterwards. - When it is done with field work and would go do something else (another job, eating, sleeping, recreation, or nothing at all), it drops off its harvest first. - Sowing right after harvesting counts as field work, so the pawn sows first and delivers afterwards. - Delivering is part of harvesting: pawns that are incapable of hauling or dumb labor still bring their own harvest in. - Urgent needs, emergencies, drafting, mental breaks, rituals and anything the player orders always come first.
Works with crops, berry bushes, trees (wood), healroot, mushrooms, and modded plants. Uses the normal storage system, so stockpiles, shelves, fridges and storage mods (e.g. LWM's Deep Storage, Adaptive Storage) work as usual.
Compatibility: no def or think-tree edits, only four small Harmony prefixes/postfixes, no transpilers. Safe to add to an existing save. Optional support for Combat Extended's inventory limits. Settings are in Options → Mod settings → Harvest and Haul.
